sets.name: pass1
sets.note: the original full-corpus API pass (v3), all 6,187 sampled films

sets.name: pass2
sets.note: weak-row re-run: --ids weak_ids.txt/boundary_ids.txt, optionally --plots and/or --prompt v2. Never overwrites pass1 in place - its own file, stamped labelset=pass2.

sets.name: hand
sets.note: the 672-film hand/reference set used by validate.py

precedence.rule: For each film id, take the highest-precedence labelset that has a label for it, with ONE exception: pass2 only outranks pass1 when pass2 actually improved on it — pass2.basis in ('text','both') (it read real plot text, pass1 usually only had a knowledge guess) OR pass2.confidence > pass1.confidence (a stronger read even from knowledge alone). Otherwise pass1's label is kept and pass2's attempt is recorded as a disagreement, not a replacement. hand always wins outright: it is never compared, only preferred. A film with no label in any set is absent from the merge.
